attchmntText: Libas Consumer Products Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Libas Consumer Products Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone net profit for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was Rs. 51.62 Lakhs, compared to Rs. 50.60 Lakhs in the same period last year. Half-year standalone net profit stood at Rs. 142.99 Lakhs against Rs. 158.30 Lakhs loss in the previous year. Basic earnings per share for the quarter was Rs. 0.20. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 1,006.07 Lakhs. The company reported an exceptional loss of Rs. 240 Lakhs for the half year due to a fire incident in May 2025. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, were Rs. 7,975.89 Lakhs. The board meeting was held on November 17, 2026. Riyaz Ganji, Managing Director, signed the results.
